cards.title: Your first line of Python
cards.body: A program is a list of instructions the computer follows from top to bottom. `print()` is the instruction that shows something on the screen.

hi.title: Python ki pehli line
hi.body: Program instructions ki ek list hai, jise computer upar se neeche tak follow karta hai. `print()` woh instruction hai jo screen par kuch dikhata hai.

cards.title: Text goes in quotes
cards.body: Text in Python is called a string. Wrap it in quotes so Python knows where it starts and ends. Each `print()` starts a new line.
cards.code:
print("I am learning Python")
print("One line at a time")
cards.output:
I am learning Python
One line at a time

hi.title: Text quotes mein jaata hai
hi.body: Python mein text ko string kehte hain. Use quotes mein rakho taaki Python ko pata chale woh kahan shuru aur kahan khatam hota hai. Har `print()` nayi line se shuru hota hai.

cards.title: Every character counts
cards.body: The grader compares your output letter by letter, so capitals, commas and spaces all matter. `Hello` and `hello` are different.

hi.title: Har character matter karta hai
hi.body: Grader aapka output letter by letter compare karta hai, isliye capitals, commas aur spaces sab matter karte hain. `Hello` aur `hello` alag hain.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: This should print three lines, but one of them is broken. Tap it.
cards.code:
print("Hello!")
print("I am learning Python)
print("One line at a time")

bug.fix: The text on line 2 has no closing quote, so Python can't tell where it ends. It needs a `"` before the `)`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse teen lines print karni chahiye, par unmein se ek tooti hui hai. Us par tap karo.
hi.fix: Line 2 ke text ka closing quote nahi hai, isliye Python ko pata nahi chalta text kahan khatam hota hai. `)` se pehle ek `"` chahiye.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The quotes only mark where the text starts and ends. They are not printed.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Quotes sirf batate hain ki text kahan shuru aur khatam hota hai. Woh khud print nahi hote.

exercise.prompt: Every programmer starts here. Print exactly `Hello, Loophole!`
exercise.promptHi: Har programmer yahin se shuru karta hai. Bilkul `Hello, Loophole!` print karo.
